name: Lifelines
description: Finds the single points of failure in your mesh: the nodes that, if they went off the air, would cut other nodes off from the network — including your own, which answers the question the rest of the list cannot: what happens to the mesh if you go silent. Frontend only.

default_enabled.description: Analyse the mesh as soon as the map loads

min_orphans.description: Only list a node if losing it would cut off at least this many others

include_own_radio.description: Count the nodes your own radio hears directly as links. Your node is a hub, so it will usually top the list — which is true, but you may want it out of the way.

recompute_ms.description: Shortest time between recomputations when reports keep arriving (ms)

zoom_to_selection.description: Move the map to whatever you just highlighted. A mesh spans provinces; a ring off-screen helps nobody.
